entries.observations: Four distinct rotor-ring silhouettes surround an open central quad frame on a blue table, with a folded cloth and closed case against golden sunflowers. Extra jar and hanging dried plants appear under the shelter. The fictional scenic quad is not a verified engineering design or real product. Rich textural shading exceeds the few-shade target.

entries.observations: Indigo dome, telescope-like silhouette, coral-blue geometric bands and tiled stair contrast with a broad turquoise sea. The cream complex and folk-inspired mosaics are invented, not a real Ukrainian coastal site, historic artifact or authenticated regional pattern. Water/stone details are richer than the requested compact treatment.

entries.observations: A coral train with three blue/yellow/purple book carts follows a curved indoor railway to matching sorting bays. Generic open-book emblems appear on carts and banner; blank spines are not actual titles. Equipment is imaginative scenic logistics, not an engineering model or proof of real automation. Detailed window and shelf lighting is retained.
